title: Persistent Memory Fabric
brief: Map current memory stores. Define memory classes (session/durable/benchmark/failure/feature/product/course). Establish promotion criteria, retrieval ranking, and cold-start recovery benchmarks.

units.title: Map all current memory stores: MEMORY.md, state/, benchmarks/, telemetry/, codebase-memory graph
Establish promotion criteria: when session memory becomes durable, when failure becomes pattern
Implement retrieval ranking: priority order for memory classes per workflow type
Build cold-start recovery protocol: what to load first, progressive enrichment
Benchmark cold-start recovery: target <=3 exchanges to reach productive state

exit_conditions: All memory stores mapped and classified
Promotion criteria defined for each memory class transition
Retrieval ranking implemented per workflow type
